test_FileMapper_basic: test the FileMapper class to map a file pathname to its binary data content
test_FileMapper_offset: test the FileMapper class with an offset specifier to read from a byte offset
test_FileMapper_offset_size: test the FileMapper class with offset and size specifiers to read a byte range
test_FileMapper_root_dir: test the FileMapper class with a root directory to resolve relative pathnames
test_FileMapper_validation: test the FileMapper class error handling for invalid input types and malformed pathnames
